newsitem.title: USA: U.S. envoys named to Uganda, Mauritania and Malawi.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoys named to Uganda, Mauritania and Malawi.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will name career diplomat Nancy Powell to be the new U.S. ambassador to Uganda, the White House said on Thursday.
It said Clinton would nominate career diplomat Timberlake Foster to be ambassador to Mauritania and career diplomat Amelia Shippy to be ambassador to Malawi.

Powell is currently the number two U.S. diplomat in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Foster has been deputy chief of mission in Kenya since 1994 while Shippy previously held the second-ranking U.S. diplomatic post in Uganda.
The three nominations require Senate confirmation.
